executiveSummary: Electron's Rust-preview path is the complete behavioral template for R09-T02: explicit env gate -> dev/packaged binary resolution -> spawn --home -> stdout LINGXI_SERVICE_READY handshake -> private instance/token read + authenticated identity -> crash restart at most once -> owned-tree-only shutdown with structurally zero-touch remote/reused paths.

lingxi-service has no --port/--token CLI flags: it binds --bind (default 127.0.0.1:0), writes a per-start owner-only token to {home}/lingxi-service/local-token.json and publishes instance.json after bind; the host must consume --home + READY addr + private records + identity.

The protocol/data-version gate must use Rust constants (lingxi_protocol handshake wire 1..=1, ContractVersions::R08_CUTOVER data_epoch=2), NOT shared/contract-versions.json (DATA_EPOCH=1, legacy Node axis; renderer tolerates [1,2]); build.json currently has no protocol fields, so A03 requires extending the build identity first.

T01 same artifact = desktop/dist-renderer (currently byte-identical tree digest to R08-A16 baseline); desktop/dist-tauri-resources is the R06-only resource UI and must not be reused; Tauri release overlay points frontendDist at ../dist-renderer and embeds it into the app binary.

DesktopHost-Tauri registers as a new desktop/src/react/host/tauri-desktop-host.ts with kind 'tauri', detected via window.__TAURI__ (withGlobalTauri already true in tauri.conf.json:8), resolution order hana > tauri > platform-alias > web; platform.js data-platform and session-actions isDesktopShell must be updated in the same change.

Lowest-risk config separation: keep desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json unchanged as the R06 base (so R06 WebDriver E2E remains reproducible) and add tauri.dev.conf.json + tauri.release.conf.json overlays driven by a Node build wrapper; overlay merge semantics must be proven by probe before relying on it.

Service binary distribution recommendation: Tauri externalBin sidecar for the executable plus bundle.resources for build.json, because R01-T06 already verified npx tauri build --bundles app and packaged .app sidecar handshake on this host; resources-only layout is a fallback pending nested-executable signing verification.

A01-A04 evidence must align with the Lead's already-landed R09 gate contract: four suites r09_t01_react_parity / r09_t01_release_offline / r09_t02_supervisor_ready / r09_t02_process_ownership, evidence under {EVIDENCE}/SUITES/<suite>/, per-case results via r09_producer.Producer (cases.json, lingxi.leaf-case-results.v1); r09_t01.py and r09_t02.py do not yet exist and currently fail honestly as NOT_IMPLEMENTED.

contracts.behavior: Electron Rust desktop mode is explicit env opt-in; default remains node
contracts.electronBehavior: LINGXI_DESKTOP_SERVER_RUNTIME: node(default) | rust(enabled) | other value throws
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: Tauri host is always rust service; it does not read this env. This makes 'no Node fallback' structural rather than branch discipline (A03).

contracts.behavior: LINGXI_HOME resolution and propagation
contracts.electronBehavior: env override else ~/.lingxi; resolved absolute and written back to process.env.LINGXI_HOME
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: Resolve once at startup (env or $HOME/.lingxi, canonicalized); same value used for spawn env and private-record reads; no re-resolution at call sites.

contracts.behavior: lingxi-service CLI surface
contracts.electronBehavior: --home is one of the required data-root sources; --bind defaults to 127.0.0.1:0; --network-mode loopback|lan; --shutdown-timeout-ms default 10000; there is NO --port and NO --token flag
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: spawn `lingxi-service --home <home>` exactly like Electron main.cjs:1437; never pass port/token; rely on READY addr + local-token.json + instance.json.

contracts.behavior: dev vs packaged service binary resolution
contracts.electronBehavior: dev: LINGXI_SERVICE_BIN (absolute) or <repo>/rust/target/debug/lingxi-service; packaged: resources/rust-service directory verification, env cannot replace the bundled binary
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: same env semantics in dev (absolute path; default repo-relative debug binary canonicalized to absolute); packaged resolves current_exe-relative sidecar + build.json and refuses env replacement.

contracts.behavior: Pre-spawn packaged build identity verification
contracts.electronBehavior: validate build.json schema/fields (schemaVersion, platform, arch, target, toolchain, appVersion, binary, sha256, contentSha256, sourceSha256); on macOS signed mutation require contentSha equality + codesign --verify --strict + --deep app; on Windows allow checksum/cert-table mutation with same signer
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: port service/manifest.rs + service/digest.rs including Mach-O/PE content digest logic; otherwise ad-hoc signing always breaks sha256 and packaged launches would be rejected. Add protocol field to this gate.

contracts.behavior: Build identity is produced by the Node packaging script
contracts.electronBehavior: pinned rustup toolchain, rust source digest, appVersion from package.json, sha256/contentSha256, staged at dist-rust-service/<mac|win|linux>-<arch>/
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: reuse the same stage; extend build.json with protocol {serverKind, wireProtocolMin, wireProtocolMax, dataEpoch} sourced from `lingxi-service --version`; add stage-tauri-service script mapping to binaries/lingxi-service-<triple> + resources/rust-service/build.json.

contracts.behavior: Refuse to start Rust service when an old Node server record exists for the same home
contracts.electronBehavior: throws RUST_DESKTOP_NODE_SERVER_INFO_PRESENT; does not delete another process's clue
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: same check and refusal before spawn; Tauri has no Node path but must not silently attach to an old kernel.

contracts.behavior: Refuse LINGXI_ALLOW_DATA_DOWNGRADE in Rust desktop
contracts.electronBehavior: throws requiring explicit recovery workflow
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: same refusal with same wording intent; recorded as failure record.

contracts.behavior: Packaged renderer content version must match shell app version
contracts.electronBehavior: artifact-boot resolves activated renderer; requires _currentContentVersion === app.getVersion() else refuse
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: T01/T02 renderer is embedded via frontendDist (no artifact-boot). Equivalent gate is build-time: record frontendDist tree digest + app version into build output metadata and verify at build stage; runtime OTA gate is out of T01/T02 scope (Q-10).

contracts.behavior: Existing instance reuse policy
contracts.electronBehavior: read instance.json; dead pid ignored; live pid gathered via token+identity; dev allows local-reused (no ownership); packaged refuses RUST_DESKTOP_EXISTING_INSTANCE_UNVERIFIED
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: same mode machine LocalOwned | LocalReused | Remote; packaged refuses reuse; reused tracks pid without Child handle so exit is zero-touch.

contracts.behavior: Spawn arguments, environment and detachment
contracts.electronBehavior: spawn(binary, ['--home', home], {cwd: dirname(binary), env:{...process.env, LINGXI_HOME, ...bridgeRuntimeEnv}, detached: platform!=='win32', stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']}); unref after ready
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: std::process::Command with --home/env/cwd, piped stdout/stderr with bounded buffers; on Unix process_group(0)/setsid so the owned tree can be converged. bridgeRuntimeEnv is Electron artifact-only and is an explicit T01/T02 gap (later T03/T05).

contracts.behavior: READY line handshake instead of fixed sleep
contracts.electronBehavior: line regex ^LINGXI_SERVICE_READY addr=(\S+) home=; stdout only; 64KiB bound; timeout SERVER_INFO_FIRST_WAIT_MS=90000; child exit before ready rejects with code/signal
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: async BufReader stdout, same regex, tokio timeout 90s, early-exit rejection, kill+confirm on failure, diagnostics record of spawn->ready timestamps (A03 proves not a fixed sleep).

contracts.behavior: Owned instance/token private records
contracts.electronBehavior: read instance.json (non-secret) and local-token.json (owner-only 0600, uid, O_NOFOLLOW); validate serverKind, pid===child.pid, homePath===realpath(home), 32-hex instanceId, token record kind/instanceId match, 32-hex token, bindAddr===READY addr
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: Rust mirror structs for the same JSON; owner-only checks on Unix; Windows private read via `lingxi-service --read-private-runtime-json` (main.rs:240-260) registered as platform-blocked in T01/T02.

contracts.behavior: Authenticated identity verification
contracts.electronBehavior: GET {baseUrl}/lingxi/v1/server/identity with Bearer; 5s per request; retry only ECONNREFUSED/ECONNRESET 20x100ms; require serverNodeKind==='lingxi-service', transport match, non-empty serverId and studioId
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: same URL/header/timeout/retry/field assertions; additionally gate instance/health wire protocol and data epoch against compiled lingxi-protocol constants (C24).

contracts.behavior: Publish connection to renderer
contracts.electronBehavior: global serverPort/serverToken/serverNodeKind/serverNodeTransport/serverHost; IPC get-server-connection-info returns {port,token,serverNodeKind,serverNodeTransport,host}; server-restarted event carries same payload
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: Tauri state + commands get_server_connection_info/get_server_port/get_server_token returning identical fields (host null locally) + server-restarted event with identical payload so the R08 renderer boot path needs no business change.

contracts.behavior: Instance record is diagnostics/identity, never liveness authority
contracts.electronBehavior: service OS file lock is the liveness authority; host uses record only to locate and then proves identity with token-authenticated HTTP; host must not delete/rewrite another instance's records
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: same division: host reads records only; PID reuse handled by record pid + token identity double check (A04 negative case).

contracts.behavior: Crash monitoring with at most one automatic restart
contracts.electronBehavior: unexpected exit -> one automatic restart; success re-monitors and broadcasts server-restarted to main/settings; second failure writes crash log + error dialog
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: watch child exit; restart only if not quitting/intentional and attempts<1; emit server-restarted; otherwise failure record + native dialog; no infinite restart loop.

contracts.behavior: Owned process tree shutdown with explicit residual reporting
contracts.electronBehavior: SIGTERM -> wait 17000ms -> SIGKILL -> wait 5000ms; unconfirmed exit keeps clues and reports PID instead of claiming clean
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: service/shutdown.rs with exact same budget constants; Unix libc::kill SIGTERM then SIGKILL; structured shutdown report {ownedPids, residual, graceMs, confirmed}; residual pids reported explicitly.

contracts.behavior: Reused and remote servers are never killed
contracts.electronBehavior: reused non-owned -> 'detached from external server' {confirmed:false}; remote branch never sets serverProcess/reusedServerPid so before-quit allows exit with zero contact
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: structural: only LocalOwned holds a Child handle; reused/remote shutdown path contains no kill code; report mode + touchedRemote=false.

contracts.behavior: Quit trigger surfaces and re-entrancy guard
contracts.electronBehavior: before-quit sets isQuitting, hides windows, computes hasActiveOwnedServer, resolveBeforeQuitServerAction allow/wait/run; second quit allowed after shutdown; _isUpdating skips
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: RunEvent::ExitRequested intercept + SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP handler that calls app.quit(); prevent_exit + async shutdown + app.exit(); QuitState mutex prevents re-entry. Without a signal handler SIGTERM kills the host immediately and skips cleanup (A04 would fail).

contracts.behavior: Remote mode shape and red lines
contracts.electronBehavior: LINGXI_DESKTOP_RUST_REMOTE_URL (http(s), explicit port, no userinfo/path/query/hash) + absolute LINGXI_DESKTOP_RUST_REMOTE_TOKEN_FILE (owner-only, 32-hex token); non-loopback cleartext requires LINGXI_DESKTOP_RUST_REMOTE_ALLOW_CLEARTEXT=1; REMOTE_URL requires runtime=rust; packaged builds refuse remote; remote does not read local instance pid and never spawns
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: reuse the same env contract for R08 fixture portability; allow only in dev builds (tauri::is_dev()/debug_assertions) and refuse packaged with REMOTE_REQUIRES_DEV_BUILD; token file owner-only; zero-touch exit.

contracts.behavior: Launch diagnostics and crash log
contracts.electronBehavior: {LINGXI_HOME}/diagnostics/desktop-launch/renderer.log JSONL + {LINGXI_HOME}/crash.log; diagnostics include HOME/runtime/connection mode/spawn/exit
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: diagnostics.rs writing {LINGXI_HOME}/diagnostics/tauri-launch/events.jsonl (resolve/spawn/ready/identity/reject/shutdown/page-load) plus a Tauri crash log; name collision with Electron crash.log requires decision (Q-09). A02/A03 consume this JSONL.

contracts.behavior: Node server-info stale record and foreign-home probe
contracts.electronBehavior: Node path only: live PID + token probe classifies alive-same-home/alive-unauthorized (blocking) vs not-hana/dead (cleanable); Rust path never reuses server-info, only refuses when it exists
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: Tauri has no Node path; implement only C07 refusal. Do NOT port stale-server-info/server-info-probe PID-reuse heuristics into Rust service lock semantics; record 'not applicable' rationale in evidence.

contracts.behavior: Protocol/data version axes and health surface
contracts.electronBehavior: public GET /lingxi/v1/health returns status/serverKind/serverVersion/wireProtocolMin/wireProtocolMax/dataEpoch; identity returns kind/transport/serverId/studioId/version; instance.json also carries wire/epoch; serverVersion() is still the 0.0.0 placeholder
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: three-layer gate: (1) build.json.protocol equals compiled lingxi-protocol constants (host may depend on lingxi-protocol per DEP-05), (2) pre-spawn manifest check, (3) post-READY instance/health/identity check. Do NOT use shared/contract-versions.json (DATA_EPOCH=1 legacy Node axis) and do NOT gate on serverVersion (0.0.0 has no discriminative power). appVersion goes through build identity.

contracts.behavior: Single-writer per home; host does not implement its own lock
contracts.electronBehavior: second instance on same home exits 3 with LINGXI_SERVICE_SINGLE_WRITER_BLOCKED stderr marker; stale record archived as instance.stale.json and taken over; OS lock is the liveness authority
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: host delegates to service; parses stderr marker and surfaces a precise error (home, recordedPid, instanceId, addr); never deletes the record and never force-kills another instance.

contracts.behavior: Windows guardian is only used by the Node path
contracts.electronBehavior: guardian checks are guarded by serverNodeKind !== 'lingxi-service'; Rust owned path uses plain child.kill()
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: Tauri Windows should use a Job Object (KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE) to bound the owned tree; no Windows machine available (BLOCKED-PLATFORM-WINDOWS-X64) so this is a registered unverified branch.

contracts.behavior: Existing R06 Tauri host assets reusable by R09
contracts.electronBehavior: independent manifest/lockfile; tauri 2.12.1 / tauri-build 2.7.2; withGlobalTauri true; commands registered in build.rs AppManifest::commands; e2e-test feature injects wdio WebDriver (optional dependency); E2E spawns CARGO_BIN_EXE and connects to http://127.0.0.1:$TAURI_WEBDRIVER_PORT/session
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: extend this crate: new commands must be added to build.rs command table AND capabilities/*.json allow lists; reuse wdio WebDriver E2E; keep base config so R06 tests remain reproducible.

contracts.behavior: Renderer host boundary contract that T01 must satisfy
contracts.electronBehavior: business code uses getDesktopHost()/usePlatform() + ServiceClient; most bridge members optional; boot hard-requires getServerConnectionInfo|getServerPort|getServerToken + appReady + onServerRestarted
contracts.tauriMinimumDesign: implement the boot baseline first; every other member gets an explicit capabilityReason + HostCapabilityError (no silent no-op); T03 completes the matrix and A05 verifies it.

transitions: Resolving -> Failed (old server-info present / downgrade env / remote contradiction)
Spawning -> Failed (spawn error / child exit before READY)
WaitingReady -> Failed (90s timeout; kill child + confirm)
VerifyingIdentity -> Ready (records + identity + version gate pass)
Remote -> Ready (identity verified, no local records/spawn)
ShuttingDown -> Stopped (owned tree confirmed gone or residual recorded)

a03a04Evidence.name: 错误二进制明确拒绝
a03a04Evidence.taskModule: scripts/rust-tauri/r09_t02.py (to be created; currently NOT_IMPLEMENTED red)
a03a04Evidence.buildRequirement: real release .app build with staged sidecar + build.json; negative injections performed in staging BEFORE tauri build (bundle signature covers injected content, avoiding the 'modified signed bundle refused by OS' confounder); all injection work in /private/tmp, never touching workspace outputs; post-build tamper only as optional secondary form with codesign failure status recorded; deterministic stub service binary/script for runtime-mismatch case (scenario environment allows deterministic external-protocol stand-ins)
preconditions: build.json extended with protocol {serverKind, wireProtocolMin, wireProtocolMax, dataEpoch} derived from lingxi-service --version
supervisor implements three-layer version gate (build manifest -> instance/health/identity)
failure path writes failure record before native dialog; automation dismisses dialog via osascript (R01 precedent)

cases.expect: correct package boots; diagnostics show spawn -> READY addr -> instance/token -> identity 200 -> published
event ordering proves READY line drives readiness; timestamps recorded; instance.json absent before READY
staging-time tampered build.json protocol (e.g. wireProtocolMax=2) => pre-spawn failure record RUST_SERVICE_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE with expected/actual; no lingxi-service spawned; non-zero exit
staging-time sidecar/manifest digest mismatch => RUST_SERVICE_DIGEST_MISMATCH pre-spawn; hashes recorded
stub service with correct READY but wrong instance wire/epoch or wrong identity => RUNTIME_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; host reaps spawned stub (pid dead); no publish
no hana-server/node server process, no server-info.json, release binary has no node-service entry strings, failure record fallbackAttempts=0
tauri-launch events + crash log contain reason/expected/actual; native dialog observed and dismissed via osascript
Rust unit test with injected short READY timeout proves timeout -> failure -> kill; avoids 90s wait in E2E

a03a04Evidence.notes: A03's 'wrong binary' is modeled as (i) staged manifest/protocol mismatch and (ii) runtime identity/version mismatch via a deterministic stub; both must be rejected before publish and must never start a second older service. Staging-time injection keeps the built .app internally signature-consistent and isolates the host's own protocol gate as the variable under test. The absence of Node in the Tauri release is additionally proven by process table + strings scan.

a03a04Evidence.buildRequirement: real Tauri build (release for owned path; debug build for remote-mode/reused cases) + real lingxi-service binaries; remote fixture service is a real local process owned by the harness
a03a04Evidence.fixture: remote service on remoteHome (loopback + explicit port, harness-owned); local Tauri client on localHome with its own owned service; process tree recorder adapted from scripts/rust-tauri/r08_t03_process_tree.mjs:77,79-86 plus tauri-host classification

cases.expect: S1 snapshot: exactly 2 lingxi-service processes (remoteHome/localHome); remote not child of host; local owned service inside host subtree

quit via SIGTERM to host (host installs signal handler -> app.quit -> graceful shutdown); if implementation lacks handler the suite records fallback AppleScript Cmd+Q and the gap is a real red until fixed
S3: local service pid gone, its workers gone, host exit 0, shutdown event {mode:'local-owned',ownedPids,residual:[]}
remote pid alive, /lingxi/v1/health + identity 200, instance.json sha unchanged, remote log has no shutdown marker, ppid unchanged
no second lingxi-service appears during/after quit; localHome has no residual instance.json (graceful service self-deletes)
dev with pre-existing service on localHome: host reports mode=local-reused + detached, service survives host exit (parity with desktop/main.cjs:6900-6908); harness cleans it afterwards
debug build + remote env: no local instance.json created, remote service untouched after client exit, host reports mode=remote,touchedRemote=false

a03a04Evidence.notes: A04 is the process-ownership probe: the only kill authority is the OwnedChild handle; remote/reused paths have no kill code. ACCOUNT: remote fixture is owned by the harness (explicitly allowed to clean up), not by the client under test.
